top_signals.title: Brazil Markets Set to Plunge on Lula’s Improbable Election Win
top_signals.summary: Brazilian markets are heading for a major rout when local trading begins after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva pulled off a stunning comeback to defeat Flávio Bolsonaro, the right-wing candidate that many investors preferred.

top_signals.title: What Democrats and Republicans fear most about each other: CNBC survey has the answers
top_signals.summary: The economy is still a key issue in the 2026 election, but voters are concerned about Trump testing the bounds of the office and Democratic Socialist polices.

top_signals.title: Behind ‘Mad Money’ was a brilliant writer viewers never saw. We lost him too soon
top_signals.summary: Jim Cramer remembers Cliff Mason, the head writer of "Mad Money," who died last week at age 41.
